name: jQuery Waypoints
description: Registers the jQuery Waypoints scroll library as a Drupal asset library, with an admin toggle to attach it site-wide.
library_dependencies: jQuery Waypoints 4.0.1 (MIT), Composer package levmyshkin/waypoints, served locally from /libraries/waypoints/lib/jquery.waypoints.min.js (no CDN)
project_description: Waypoints is a small jQuery plugin that makes it easy to execute a function whenever you scroll to an element. It makes a solid base for modern UI patterns that depend on a user's scroll position on the page. The Drupal module packages the levmyshkin/waypoints library (v4.0.1) as a Drupal asset library named waypoints/waypoints, served locally from /libraries/waypoints/lib/jquery.waypoints.min.js. An admin settings form (/admin/config/user-interface/waypoints, gated by the 'configure waypoints module' permission) exposes a single checkbox, 'Always include JavaScript file to the site'; when checked, hook_page_attachments attaches the library on every page. Otherwise other modules or themes attach waypoints/waypoints from their own render arrays or #attached. Views Load More supports this module.
